boarding_points.name: Porto de Manaus (Porto Flutuante / Cais das Torres)
boarding_points.operator: Porto de Manaus concession / SNPH (organized public port)
boarding_points.notes: Historic floating port (1902) — billed as the world's largest floating pier, built to ride the Rio Negro's >10 m seasonal range; cruise-ship berth (up to 4 ships simultaneously) and regional passenger quays; departure point for Encontro das Águas excursions.
boarding_points.source: https://portodemanaus.com.br/ ; OSM ferry_terminal 'Porto Público de Manaus' (cross-checked)

boarding_points.name: Terminal Ajato (fast-launch terminal, Manaus Moderna waterfront)
boarding_points.operator: Private ajato operators (Ajato 2000 and others), regulated by ARSEPAM
boarding_points.notes: Dedicated fast-launch ('ajato') terminal — the proven speed-premium trade: Parintins R$380–450 vs R$150 conventional cap; Ajato 2000 operating 22+ years.

boarding_points.name: Porto da Manaus Moderna (regional riverboat quay / new federal terminal)
boarding_points.operator: Today informal quays regulated by ARSEPAM; new terminal delivered by Ministério de Portos e Aeroportos + DNIT (Novo PAC)
boarding_points.notes: Main regional riverboat embarkation for 61 river municipalities; R$875.9M federal rebuild underway (contract signed Mar 2026, completion 2029, ~3.5M pax/yr design capacity, ~4,000 pax/day passenger terminal) — clean-fleet design-in window.

boarding_points.name: Porto da CEASA
boarding_points.operator: Private crossing operators, fares ANTAQ-approved; embarkation rules by ARSEPAM
boarding_points.notes: Vehicle-ferry and lancha terminal for the Careiro da Várzea crossing (only link to the BR-319 south bank); closest departure point to the Encontro das Águas confluence — fast confluence tours leave from here (R$20 pp / R$80 per boat).

boarding_points.name: Porto do Careiro (Careiro da Várzea balsa landing)
boarding_points.operator: Crossing operators (Gutierrez et al.), fares ANTAQ-approved
boarding_points.notes: South-bank landing of the CEASA crossing; gateway to BR-319 and the Careiro da Várzea municipality; ~8-min lancha crossing, service 04:30–20:00.

boarding_points.name: Marina do Davi (Ponta Negra)
boarding_points.operator: ACAMDAF cooperative (river-transport professionals of Marina do Davi)
boarding_points.notes: The Rio Negro west-bank gateway — cooperative lanchas to river communities, Tupé beaches and jungle lodges; behind the Tropical Hotel; state tourism agency lists it as the boat-excursion departure point.

boarding_points.name: Tropical Hotel landing (Ponta Negra)
boarding_points.operator: Hotel Tropical complex (hotel operation suspended for years; landing mapped in OSM)
boarding_points.notes: Historic jungle-resort waterfront landing next to Marina do Davi; hotel has been largely closed/in redevelopment — treat as a candidate hospitality node pending on-ground confirmation of berthing status.
boarding_points.source: OSM ferry_terminal 'Tropical Hotel' (coordinate verified; operational status unverified)

boarding_points.name: Ponta Negra beach waterfront
boarding_points.notes: The city's flagship beach and events waterfront (hotel and residential density); no fixed passenger pier verified — coordinate is the beach itself; shallow-draft (N35 1.5 ft) or a light float would be required.
boarding_points.source: OSM/Nominatim 'Praia da Ponta Negra' -3.0624697,-60.1037537 (coordinate verified; no pier verified)

boarding_points.name: Praia do Tupé (REDES do Tupé)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Manaus (Tupé sustainable development reserve, Rio Negro west bank)
boarding_points.operator: Community landing; access via ACAMDAF lanchas from Marina do Davi
boarding_points.notes: Signature Rio Negro river beach and community inside the municipal REDES do Tupé reserve; established cooperative lancha destination from Marina do Davi.

boarding_points.name: Balsa do São Raimundo
boarding_points.operator: Historic municipal crossing point (largely dormant since the Rio Negro bridge opened, 2011)
boarding_points.notes: West-of-centre balsa slip that historically served the Cacau Pirêra (Iranduba) crossing; mapped in OSM — a natural mid-town node if a waterfront line is revived.
boarding_points.source: OSM ferry_terminal 'Balsa do São Raimundo' (coordinate verified; service dormant)

boarding_points.name: Porto Balsa Cacau Pirêra (Iranduba)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Iranduba (Cacau Pirêra, Rio Negro west bank)
boarding_points.operator: Historic crossing landing (traffic moved to the Rio Negro bridge, 2011)
boarding_points.notes: West-bank pair of the São Raimundo crossing; Iranduba side of the Rio Negro — candidate node for a revived cross-river spur.
boarding_points.source: OSM ferry_terminal 'Porto Balsa Cacau Pireira' (coordinate verified; service dormant)

boarding_points.name: Marina Rio Bello (Tarumã)
boarding_points.notes: Private leisure marina up the Tarumã-Açu inlet north of Ponta Negra — recreational-fleet density and a charging-host candidate for the Rio Negro leisure mesh.
